summary: Preserved and consolidated PR #2700's verified C2 boundary-row correction onto the prepared base. Independent reproduction found no further concrete defect in PR #2700: PR #2732's remaining counterexamples are unavailable end-to-end qualification paths. The broader DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark feature therefore remains incomplete and must not be represented as solved.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate commit 3a026796b162b43de63bef6ba5e2e609524dc8e7, 93 tests and 17 subtests passed for C2 endpoint-local mapping/registration and Mooncake/NIXL protocol helpers; raw output is in raw/candidate-focused-tests.log.

tests.command: Execute the base and candidate get_dsv4_c4_state_indices implementations for N=101 with rings 2 and 8, plus candidate N=102
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before/passing-after: base rejects legal ring 2 and returns five rows for ring 8; candidate returns source row 6, destination row 28, and an empty even-boundary payload. Raw output is in raw/failing-before-passing-after.log.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e8b4a548a397/venv/bin/python < inline C2 row-copy numerical check
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X with ROCm 7.2, copied one 4096-byte FP32 row from independently computed source row 6 to destination row 60; it exactly matched a CPU arange reference and the neighboring row remained untouched. Raw output is in raw/gpu-row-copy.log.

remaining_limitations: No end-to-end DeepSeek-V4.1 PD + DSpark generation was run with Mooncake or NIXL.
Streaming and concurrent request behavior remain unverified.
Chunked prefill and prefix-cache restoration, including odd prefix hits and separation of H from N, remain unverified; decode radix cache is explicitly rejected with speculative decoding.
First draft/verify, partial and full rejection, accepted-token commit, C2 reuse, and Engram-history updates remain unverified end to end.
Cancellation, stale-write prevention, source-release ordering, and request-slot reuse remain unverified.
Generation parity against a non-disaggregated DeepSeek-V4.1 reference, actual speculative acceptance, and throughput remain unmeasured.
The assigned ROCm/HIP architecture cannot execute DSpark because _handle_dspark explicitly accepts CUDA or NPU only; changing that guard without implementation evidence would be speculative.
No DeepSeek-V4.1 target/draft weights or real multi-process/cross-node Mooncake/NIXL topology were available. The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify this architecture or distributed DSpark semantics.
No native code changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable; the pinned Torch/ROCm stack was preserved.
